ShortDescription.Value: Post office fixes, mail tweaks, and capacity controls.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Magic Mail + Fixes - Adjust all postal van limits and capacity. - Control post offices, sorting facilities, and postal trucks. - Also provides some optional fixes for the mail system.
### How to Use
- **Quick Start Button** 1-Click to apply all recommended settings. - not sure what to do? Just use this button, done - play with a better working mail system. - don't forget to Like 👍(top right)
### Power Users - Adjust post-van mail load multiplier, number of postal vans, or mail semi trucks. - Boost speed and storage capacity for sorting facilities. - Simple city-wide mail statistics and recent activity in the Status tab. - All items are Optional and can be reset to game defaults (vanilla).
### Mail fixes - all optional; the mod can also be used only to adjust mail capacity.
1. **Postal Dispatch Assist** lets normal transfers try first, then tops up Local Mail if it stays too low for several checks. 2. **auto Fix** mail overflow by trimming overfilled mail buffers so they do not remain blocked forever (for PO and Sorters). 3. **Postal Dispatch Assist** does the same for Unsorted Mail at dedicated sorting facilities.
Currently, cargo shipyards could be shipping out most of the unsorted mail leaving very little for local sorting (reference below). 4. Fixes are workaround solutions until Pdx/IFS fixes the mail transfer process.
### 15+ Languages supported
Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, 你好, 안녕하세요, Olá, 你好, こんにちは, Cześć, สวัสดี, Xin chào, Merhaba, Привіт
### Compatibility - Safe to remove any time; postal facilities will fall back to the game's default. - Does not use Harmony, less likely to break with game updates.
### Support and Feedback - If the mod helps you, give it a Like (top right) :) - feedback on Github link, or Discord (icons on the right). - Be aware of copies of mods where no link is given to Github source code, so anything could be in them. The Github link is a simple safety check.
### Credits
- River-Mochi - author - BugsyG - testing - Inspired by Infixo's original Postal Helper
Reference: some of the known mail problems acknowledged by the game: https://www.paradoxinteractive.com/games/cities-skylines-ii/news/bridges-bikes-bugfixes - There are no patch notes after the Sept. 2025 diary that these postal fixes were done and Colossal departed. - patch 1.6.2 has a small update for any postal building that includes a sorting upgrade (i.e. Westmont Tower).

Publish.ChangeLog: - Updated for game 1.6.2. - Mail rescues now let normal game transfers try first before stepping in. - Added support for post offices with sorting upgrades, including SK Westmont Tower. - Recommended sorting speed is now 150%; post-van mail load remains 200%. - Added an on-demand Write Report button for troubleshooting.
